displayDescription.en: A 6-role foreign trade team covering buyer sourcing, background checks, Teyi company lists and contact lists with MCP workbench data exchange, role-tailored outreach emails, customer profiling and intelligence reports. The lead dispatches the right specialist and delivers ready-to-use results.
displayDescription.zh: 六位外贸专家协作，覆盖客户搜索、背调、特易公司/联系人列表处理、入库与千人千面开发信，智能调度。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我开发一批欧美市场的潜在客户，并给出背景调查和客户画像。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me source potential buyers in Europe and the US, with background checks and customer profiles.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据客户背景，写一封高回复率的外贸开发信。
quickPrompts.en: Write a high-reply-rate foreign trade outreach email based on the customer's background.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份特易表是一家公司加多个联系人，从工作台拉取公司资料后，按联系人职位写千人千面开发信。
quickPrompts.en: This Teyi sheet is one company with many contacts: pull the company record from the workbench, then write role-tailored outreach emails.
